blocks.text: Instead of explicitly defining each server, you can allow Private Access (ZPA) to discover the appropriate servers for your applications as users request them. To learn more, see Understanding Application Discovery. The following procedure covers how to complete this task on the Server Groups page, however you also can complete this task when defining a new application. To learn more, see Configuring Defined Application Segments.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Private Access > Private Applications > Segment Groups.
The Add Server Group drawer opens.
In the Add Server Group drawer:
Name: Enter a name for the server group. The name cannot contain special characters, with the exception of periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores ( _ ).
Status: Select whether to enable or disable the server group.

Dynamic Server Discovery: Enable to allow Private Access to discover the appropriate servers for your applications as users request them. By default, this setting is enabled. If you disable this setting, the Servers drop-down menu appears for you to manually select servers.
Connector Type: Choose one of the following options:

App Connector: Select to use an App Connector to connect to applications that are accessible via App Connectors. From the App Connector Groups drop-down menu, choose the groups that are applicable to the server group. You can search for a specific group, click the Delete icon next to a selection to remove it, or click Clear All to remove all selections.

Extranet: Select to use Private Access to connect to an application at a partner site via Extranet Application Support. From the Extranet Resource drop-down menu, select the applicable extranet resource that was configured in Internet & SaaS (ZIA). You can choose only one partner per server group.
After you select an extranet resource, the following drop-down menus appear:

Extranet Location Groups: Choose a location group if your organization created extranet location groups in Internet & SaaS. The location group represents the set of all the IPSec tunnels that can reach the application at partner locations.

You can expand the location group to view all locations associated with that group. If you want to include all those locations, you do not need to select an option for Extranet Locations. If you want to select a subset of those locations, you can select those in Extranet Locations.
Extranet Locations: Choose the locations that can reach the application at a partner site using an IPSec tunnel.
